node.label: Frederick Cooper
node.date_label: Decolonization and African Society (1996) · Colonialism in Question (2005) · Empires in World History (with Jane Burbank) (2010)
node.description: A historian of Africa, labour and empire who tests large concepts against changing and unequal relationships. His interview distinguishes colonial power from total domination and imperial citizenship from an assumed national endpoint.

proposed_edges.relationship: Studies African labour and exploitation without assuming universal proletarianization.
proposed_edges.evidence_note: Cooper’s opening autobiographical answers distinguish post-slavery labour, land and uneven colonial power.

proposed_edges.relationship: Treats empire and citizenship relationally across scales and alternative political possibilities.
proposed_edges.evidence_note: The interview’s citizenship and historical-sequences answers warn against reading national outcomes backwards. Coauthored books retain Jane Burbank’s credit.
